SCOPE OF THE JOB 1.0 PROJECT DESCRIPTION/SITE INFORMATION This tender envisages detailed design, engineering, manufacturing, fabric ation, inspection, supply, transportation and delivery of the following roof systems for existing above-ground storage tanks at HPCL Chennai New Te rminal, Ennore: A. Aluminium Geodesic Dome Roofs (AGDR) for existing above-ground s torage tanks.

B. Aluminium Internal Floating Roofs (IFR) for existing Motor Spirit ( MS) and High-Speed Diesel (HSD) storage tanks and Hybrid Floating Roofs for existing Ethanol storage tanks. The above works shall be treated as independent jobs, each having separ ate design, engineering, manufacturing, fabrication, inspection, supply, d elivery, erection supervision, testing and commissioning assistance requir ements, as specified in the respective technical specifications and price s chedules. The jobs may be undertaken independently, at different times a nd on different tanks, as per HPCL requirements. Wherever Aluminium Geodesic Dome Roofs (AGDR) and Internal Floating Roofs (IFR)/Hybrid Floating Roofs are specified for the same tank, the resp ective vendors shall ensure proper dimensional, structural and operationa l compatibility between both systems. In case the works are awarded to different vendors, both vendors shall be responsible for coordinating and exchanging necessary design drawings, t echnical details and interface requirements to ensure compatibility and sa tisfactory installation and operation of both roof systems. Any interface-rel ated discrepancies shall be jointly resolved by the respective vendors in c onsultation with HPCL, without any additional cost to HPCL. Physical erection and tank modifications shall be carried out by HPCL-app ointed contractor(s) unless specifically included elsewhere in the price sch edule. The vendor shall provide technical supervision and assistance as d efined under each package. The Project site location address is as below: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited Chennai New Terminal, Ennore, Chennai, Ta mil Nadu 600120 2.0 SCOPE OF WORK The tender comprises the following separate scopes. Each scope is to be r ead together with its applicable technical specifications, tank data sheets, drawings and price schedule. All package-specific deliverables and obligat ions remain separately applicable: 2.1 ALUMINIUM GEODESIC DOME ROOFS (AGDR) The scope of the work includes as below but not limited to the following: 1) The vendor shall furnish all engineering, materials, manufacturing fa cilities, equipment, tools and services required for design, fabrication , supply, delivery, erection supervision, testing assistance and commi ssioning assistance of complete Aluminium geodesic dome roof syste ms. Design shall comply with the applicable edition of API 650, Annex G, and project-specific technical requirements, subject to HPCL appro

val. 2) The vendor shall visit the site and verify all relevant dimensions, me asurements and existing conditions of the tanks prior to submission o f the bid. The tank shell plate thicknesses and details of existing app urtenances provided in the attached data sheets are indicative and f or reference only. The vendor shall assess the structural adequacy of the existing tank shell to withstand all applicable loads imposed by th e proposed Aluminium Geodesic Dome Roof and identify any reinforc ement or modifications required. The vendor shall submit the necess ary design calculations, drawings and technical recommendations to HPCL for execution of such modifications through its designated cont ractor. No additional claims arising from inadequate site assessment or unfamiliarity with existing site conditions shall be entertained duri ng execution of the work. 3) The vendor and its personnel shall comply with HPCL safety, security , permit-to-work and operational terminal requirements. All site visits and supervision shall be coordinated with the Engineer-in-Charge. 4) The dome shall be designed to accommodate all existing tank access ories, including foam systems, foam pourers, level/radar gauges, gau ge wells, vents and instrumentation. The vendor shall provide necess ary drawings and details for openings, supports and sealing arrange ments to ensure proper installation and compatibility with existing eq uipment. The locations of all accessories shall be verified with the tan k drawings and actual site conditions. 5) The dome shall be designed to provide safe access for inspection an d maintenance of the Internal Floating Roof (IFR). Adequate clearanc e shall be maintained for the free movement of the IFR and access to its seals and fittings. 6) The vendor shall submit detailed design calculations, drawings and material details for all the modifications required on the tank shell lik e modifications in extension plates, Foam pourer plate, gauge wells a nd any other accessories. The modifications shall be carried out by HPCL through its designated contractor. Howe ver, the vendor shall remain responsible for the correctness of the su bmitted design and drawings. 7) Provision of Triangular skylight panels shall be provided as per stand ard. The vendor shall submit details of the number, location, material and sealing arrangements for HPCL approval. 8) The dome shall have suitable inspection openings, access hatches an d maintenance arrangements as per applicable standards. These shal l be located without interfering with existing tank equipment and IFR operation. 9) The vendor shall provide necessary design and drawings for access walkways, platforms, handrails and supports to ensure safe inspectio n and maintenance of the dome roof, as per applicable safety standar ds (OSHA) and HPCL requirements. 10) The dome shall be designed to withstand all applicable loads, includi ng dead load, live load, wind load, seismic load and temperature vari ations, as per relevant design codes. The design shall also consider p roper load transfer to the tank shell, thermal expansion and preventio n of corrosion between different metals. 11) The vendor shall specify the aluminium grade, roof panel thickness,

fasteners, gaskets, sealants and other materials used in the dome. T he supply shall include all structural members, roof panels, supports, brackets, connections, fasteners, seals and other accessories require d for complete installation of the dome roof. 12) The dome roof, including all joints and openings, shall be designed t o prevent rainwater leakage. The vendor shall submit the necessary t esting procedure and acceptance criteria for HPCL approval. The desi gn shall also ensure proper tank ventilation and compatibility with exi sting pressure-vacuum arrangements, wherever applicable. 13) The vendor shall provide necessary design and details for electrical bonding, earthing and lightning protection of the dome roof in coordi nation with HPCL and as per applicable standards. 14) The design, manufacturing and inspection of dome roof materials sh all be carried out through an HPCL-approved Third Party Inspection A gency (TPIA) as per the approved Quality Assurance Plan (QAP). Inspe ction shall include design verification, raw materials, fabrication, dim ensions, finished components and packing. Materials shall be dispatc hed only after obtaining clearance from HPCL/TPIA. 15) The vendor/manufacturer shall provide qualified and authorised repr esentatives to supervise the erection, testing and commissioning of t he dome roof by HPCL's appointed contractor. The vendor shall ensur e that the dome is installed as per approved drawings and specificati ons and shall certify its satisfactory installation. Any defects arising fr om incorrect design, defective materials or improper technical superv ision shall be rectified by the vendor. 16) The emission norms after completion of dome roof shall be complian t with later MOEF notification 2008 for IFR tanks and certificate of co mpliance shall be given thru a MOEF Approved consultant and necess ary statutory compliance to be obtained from respective /applicable statutory authorities to that effe ct. All the statutory norms/regulations applicable in the job like PESO/ PCB/Factories/ any other applicable statutory authorities shall be com plied with and shall form the part of the subject job. 17) The vendor shall ensure proper packing, identification, protection an d transportation of all dome roof materials to HPCL Chennai New Ter minal. Necessary precautions shall be taken to prevent damage durin g transportation, unloading and storage, and suitable handling and st orage instructions shall be provided. 18) The vendor's scope shall include all materials, accessories, design d etails and associated services necessary for successful supply, install ation supervision, testing and commissioning of the Aluminium Geode sic Dome Roof, even if not specifically mentioned but essential for co mpletion of the specified scope. 2.2 ALUMINIUM INTERNAL FLOATING ROOFS (IFR) AND HYBRID FL OATING ROOFS 1) The vendor shall provide all engineering, materials, manufacturing f acilities, equipment, tools and services required for design, fabricatio n, supply, delivery, erection supervision, testing assistance and com missioning assistance of complete Aluminium Internal Floating Roofs for MS and HSD tanks and Hybrid Floating Roofs for Ethanol tanks. Th

e design shall comply with the applicable requirements of API 650, An nex H, relevant standards and project-specific technical specifications , subject to HPCL approval. 2) The vendor shall visit the site and verify all relevant dimensions, me asurements and existing conditions of the tanks prior to submission o f the bid. The tank dimensions, shell plate thicknesses and details of existing appurtenances provided in the attached data sheets are indi cative and for reference only. The vendor shall verify the suitability of the existing tanks for installation of the proposed floating roofs and id entify any modifications or reinforcements required. Necessary desig n calculations, drawings and recommendations shall be submitted to HPCL for execution through its designated contractor. No additional cl aims arising from inadequate site assessment or unfamiliarity with ex isting site conditions shall be entertained. 3) The vendor and its personnel shall comply with HPCL safety, security , permit-to-work and operational terminal requirements. All site visits and supervision shall be coordinated with the Engineer-in-Charge. 4) The floating roofs shall be designed to accommodate all existing tan k accessories, including foam systems, foam pourers, level/radar gau ges, gauge wells, vents and instrumentation. The vendor shall provid e necessary drawings and details for openings, supports and sealing arrangements to ensure proper installation and compatibility with exi sting equipment. The locations of all accessories shall be verified with the tank drawings and actual site conditions. 5) The Aluminium Internal Floating Roofs for MS and HSD tanks and Hy brid Floating Roofs for Ethanol tanks shall be designed to provide ade quate buoyancy, structural strength, stability and smooth floating op eration throughout the specified operating range. The design shall pr event tilting, sinking or interference with existing tank components d uring normal operation. 6) The vendor shall submit detailed design calculations, drawings and material details for all modifications required to accommodate the flo ating roofs, including modifications to gauge wells, guide poles, roof s upports, foam systems, tank nozzles and other accessories. Such mo difications shall be carried out by HPCL through its designated contra ctor. However, the vendor shall remain responsible for the correctnes s of the submitted design and drawings. 7) The floating roofs shall be provided with suitable peripheral sealing a rrangements to minimize vapor losses and ensure compatibility with t he respective stored products. The seal materials for MS, HSD and Et hanol services shall be selected considering their chemical compatibil ity, durability and applicable emission control requirements 8) The floating roofs shall be provided with suitable support legs or oth er approved supporting arrangements to maintain the required mini mum clearance from the tank bottom when the tank is emptied. The vendor shall submit details of support locations, heights, load distribu tion and landing arrangements for HPCL approval. 9) The floating roofs shall have suitable maintenance provisions as per applicable standards. The design shall permit safe inspection, mainte nance and replacement of seals, fittings and other components witho ut unnecessary interference with existing tank equipment 10) The floating roofs shall be designed to withstand all applicable

loads, including dead load, live load, buoyancy forces, operational loa ds and other loads specified in relevant design codes. The design sha ll consider proper load distribution, structural stability, thermal expan sion and prevention of corrosion between dissimilar metals. 11) The vendor shall specify the Aluminium grade, thickness of deck pan els, structural members, fasteners, gaskets, seals and other material s used in the floating roofs. For Hybrid Floating Roofs intended for Ethanol service, the vendor shall clearly specify the materials and co nstruction of all components. All materials shall be compatible with th e respective stored products and operating conditions. 12) The floating roofs shall be designed to minimize product vapor emissions and prevent leakage through deck joints, seals and fittings. The vendor shall submit necessary inspection and testing procedures , including buoyancy, leak-tightness and functional testing requireme nts, for HPCL approval. 13) The vendor shall provide necessary design and details for electrical bonding, earthing and static electricity dissipation arrangements for t he floating roofs in accordance with applicable standards and HPCL r equirements. The arrangements shall ensure electrical continuity between the floating roof and tank s tructure throughout the operating range. 14) The design, manufacturing and inspection of floating roof materials s hall be carried out through an HPCL-approved Third Party Inspection Agency (TPIA) as per the approved Quality Assurance Plan (QAP). Ins pection shall include design verification, raw materials, fabrication, di mensions, finished components and packing. Materials shall be dispat ched only after obtaining clearance from HPCL/TPIA. 15) The vendor/manufacturer shall provide qualified and authorised repr esentatives to supervise the erection, testing and commissioning of t he floating roof by HPCL's appointed contractor. The vendor shall ens ure that the floating roof is installed as per approved drawings and s pecifications and shall certify its satisfactory installation. Any defects arising from incorrect design, defective materials or improper technic al supervision shall be rectified at risk and cost of the Vendor. 16) The emission norms after completion of internal floating roof shall b e compliant with later MOEF notification 2008 for IFR tanks and certifi cate of compliance shall be given thru a MOEF Approved consultant a nd necessary statutory compliance to be obtained from respective /a pplicable statutory authorities to that effect. All the statutory norms/r egulations applicable in the job like PESO/PCB/Factories/ any other ap plicable statutory authorities shall be complied with and shall form th e part of the subject job. 17) The vendor shall ensure proper packing, identification, protection an d transportation of all floating roof materials to HPCL Chennai New Te rminal. Necessary precautions shall be taken to prevent damage duri ng transportation, unloading and storage, and suitable handling and s torage instructions shall be provided. 18) The vendor's scope shall include all materials, accessories, design d etails and associated services necessary for successful supply, install ation supervision, testing and commissioning of the Aluminium Intern al Floating Roofs and Hybrid Floating Roofs, even if not specifically m entioned but essential for completion of the specified scope.
